campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from University of Iowa Housing & Dining's official residence-hall pages. Iowa publishes the room types in every hall, the bathroom arrangement in unusual detail (community, single-user, suite and private) and exact furniture dimensions — lofted bed frame, desk and closet — but states that room layout and size vary and gives no per-room figure, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback and is labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." Beds are extra-long twin (36" x 80") on lofted frames with 58 inches of clearance underneath, which is worth planning around. Every hall is air conditioned.
